talas.t: Cannot sleep. Heating in the block is on but the radiator only knocks
Kayırluu tañ. Frost on the car again. -2 they say
Kayırluu tañ! Brr. Is the 14 running this morning or should I walk
Running. Came at 7:20 today, no delay. Driver was in a good mood lol
Rahmat! Walking is for people with no shoes 😂
Kids need hats today. The little one refused and now she has a cold 🙄
Big coat on. Bazar opens at 8, the changers already have the board up
Board says USD 11.45 buy 11.95 sell. Still the same spread as last week
Who is selling a used screen? Mine is basically a mosaic now 📱
Rustam go to the counter by the Liberty end, they had a rack last month
Rahmat. Going at lunch
Nurzhan air on my phone app says 150 this morning. Mother says open no windows. Talas 91 here so I'm happy to be in Talas
Talas is moderate. Ok, I'm taking the kids out to the park anyway, they need air
Nurzhan 150 is bad for asthma people. Take it seriously Nurbek
Yes I know Timur. Sorry for the bad joke
Potatoes in the inner rows of Bazar-i Kalan 2.10 a kilo this week. Sack price about the same as last time
2.10 is fine. Not like 2 som in October lol. Taking one sack
Good. Dig nothing 🥔
Those two horses at the Hippodrome need hay. Hay bale 26 som in the valleys now, the Chu boys say
26 for a bale? Last year 19. Marat you feed them like kings
They are kings. Cheaper than a new tyre pump 😤
Quick one: anyone going to the Thursday exchange tonight? I'm bringing the cards for the present tense game
I'm coming! Will the boorsok be warm?
It's 18:30 Rustam, not the morning. Teahouse behind philology, they keep it warm
Haha ok, see you 18:30 🙏
Lunch at the exchange booth. Dollar still dull, the board hasn't moved since 8
Bank counter had a queue of 20 people for som notes. Everyone wants clean ones for the bazar
Clean ones always, the old crumpled ones nobody wants 😅
Anyone heard about the Tulparcoin thing? Someone at work says it dropped. Not legal tender anyway
It's an offshore quote, 3.44 cents this noon, -6.4% on the day. Ignore it, it's a toy
A toy that costs 3 cents lol 😂
My grandson wanted to buy it. I said buy potatoes instead
Kindergarten is out early, the heating in the hall broke. Three kids with runny noses already
Ugh. Hope it's fixed by tomorrow
Sent a note to the director. Will see 🙄
Anyone tried the new marshrutka to Kyzyl-Adyr? 30 som, cheap but driver drives like a horse 🐎
Insult to horses. Horses drive better
Kyzyl-Adyr is cloudy and 12 today, warm for them
Got the screen! Cracked one is in the drawer 📱
Rustam fix your own phone first 😂
I did! Thanks for the discount Kanat, you know who you are
Exchange is open! Boorsok and teahouse, come in 🥟
Here. Only one student asked me to say a word in Iradi, I said 'boorsok' 😅
That's the right word Rustam 😄
Tulpar at 21:00 on the State Hippodrome next month? No, wait, that's the Talas v Dastgoh chess... no. Tulpar plays Tulpar. Sorry, tired
Timur you can't be serious. Tulpar played Neftchi on the 31st, lost 2-1. Irad League is finished now, champs are Neftchi
Yes I know, 63 pts vs our 62. We needed a miracle 😔
One point. Ugly way to lose the title
Irad Cup final is 7 Nov already, Neftchi 2-0 Attelkom. Done. Nothing left this season
Nothing left except the ulak. Bigger drama 😂
Ulak round 10 on Saturday: Talas v Dastgoh at 21:00 on the State Hippodrome. Who is going?
I'll be there with the horses. Late ride home
Talas is top of ISEZ with 22 but Chu has 23 and played 9. Careful
Chu has 23 from 9 games. Our lot have 22 from 8. We need Dastgoh to lose
Dastgoh lost 7-2 at Köhne Diz on Saturday. Maybe they're in trouble
Köhne Diz is bottom half. Tough one for Talas 😬
Students want to go with me to watch. Saturday is good, who's bringing thermos?
I bring the thermos, you bring the kids 😄
Heating in Talas fine now, the district says district heating is on everywhere. Radiators warm at last
Mine is warm too. My neighbour says the Nurzhan ones are cold because the air is bad, what?
That's not how radiators work Elnur lol. But Nurzhan IS bad, 150 today
Rustam you're still in Nurzhan air bubble in your head. Talas 91 is fine
Power normal here, no cuts scheduled. Good. Lights on in the potato store 💡
Tyre shop is cold but the pump works today 😎
Kara-Suu canyon car park brought IS 610,000 to Sary-Bulak in nine months. Good for the guides
Ha Begaiym. Ask for the receipt
Fergana gateway is open at Ala-Bel, chains needed. Going to Nurzhan on Saturday, chains in the boot
Good luck Timur. Suusamyr is closed for winter, so don't even try
[poll: Saturday ulak at the Hippodrome: going?]
Yes
Maybe, depends on the cashier shift
Kanat says the new kid at the counter is a genius. Fixed my charger in 2 min 😎
Ask him about the cracked tail of the cat too
Night birds! Talas air 91 tonight, windows shut. Sleep well 🌙
Night all. Bread for Sunday, Elnur, don't forget 😄
Got it, 3 loaves at 3.50, Sunday 🍞
Frost tonight, talas low -2. Dress warm
Big coat again 🧥
Early shift tomorrow. Tınç uyku all
Dig nothing 🥔
[sticker: horse_love]
Night Talas 🌙
Who is still awake lol
Me. Cant sleep, the heater clicks all night
Clicks means its working right?
Kayırluu tañ. Frost on the car, -2 on my phone
Kayırluu tañ! Mountains white again 🏔️
Kids want to go out in the snow before school, I said no until the coats are on 😅
Is the 14 running today or do I walk
Running. Saw it at the North Terminal 5 min ago
Rahmat 🙏 walking would kill me
Morning. Doors open at the booth. Small queue already, people buying som before the weekend trip
Going to Kyzyl-Adyr for the tyres? Marshrutka there is 30 som, cheaper than my fuel 😄
Marshrutka to Kyzyl-Adyr 30 som, ok noted. Not going, I work
Saw the Herald this morning: Nurzhan air hit 183 on Sunday. Gidromet says mornings indoors
Sunday was bad, I could taste it in the bazar. Kids at home all day
Gidromet always says mornings indoors. Easy to say from an office 🙄
Still 149 in Nurzhan today so I'll take Talas air, 97 is fine
Talas 97 today. See, I said so 😏
Sleeping is for people with no shift. Bank is full of old men with pension cards already
Old men with pension cards are the ones who pay on time 😂
Anyone know what the hay is going for in the valleys this year? My brother needs to buy for the cows
26 som a bale in the valleys last I heard. Dear for a bad year
26 for hay, my horses eat more than my kids 😂
Your kids eat more than your horses Marat, I've seen you at the bazar 😄
Anyone going to the Irad Cup final on Saturday? Neftchi vs Attelkom. Oh wait, it's the 7th, that was last Saturday. Final is the 7th, it already happened?
Nurbek the final is next Saturday, the 7th... no wait, today is the 13th. So it's not played yet. Neftchi v Attelkom on the 7th, that's a date we have passed
I'm confused lol. Ok, the Irad Cup final was on Sat 7 Nov, Neftchi 2-0 Attelkom
Yes Nurbek, it was 7 Nov, Neftchi won 2-0. Rest of us had a quiet weekend 😂
Neftchi champions, Tulpar second. Gap of 1 point and no rounds left, we lost 2-1 to them last 31 Oct, ugh
One point 😭 Tulpar fans are still singing
Tulpar is 2nd, that is still a good season. Better than last year
Who fixes a phone around here, I have a cracked screen and a dead battery
Ask at the counter by the Bazar-i Kalan gate. The new kid is a genius, Kanat says
Ha, that's me 😎 I work the counter
He's not joking, he fixed my charger 😂
Dollar at the changers this morning 11.50 buy, 11.90 sell. Bank says 8.40 but who is counting
Marat we are not the bank. Our booth rate is posted at the window. Ask the cashier not the tyre shop 😂
Cashier I asked. Sell 11.90 to me, I buy 11.50 from you, kidding
Kids are asking if they can see the snow on the mountains from school. Yes, it's beautiful
Tomorrow I'm doing English with the 3rd years on winter words. Snow, frost, coat. 🧥
Teach them 'dig nothing', that's the important one
Yes Nurbek, teach them the potato words first
Lunch: plov at the Tündük, 28 som a plate. Still worth it
28 for plov and they still forget the carrots. Ask for more carrots 😤
Nurzhan refinery smell came over the hills at lunch. Glad I'm in Talas
Rustam shut your window 😄
Did anyone see the Kara-Suu canyon story? Car park and guide fees brought in IS 610,000 in nine months
Good for the guides. My cousin is one, says the tourists just want photos of the cliffs
Tourists want photos with the horses. I charge them 100 for a photo 😎
Marat, that's a scam 😂
Its a professional rate
Who knows if the Fergana gateway is still open? Timur was going to Nurzhan on Saturday
Open at Ala-Bel with chains, I went through last night. Snow on the top section, careful
Rahmat. Chains in the boot 🙏
Anyone want to play cards Saturday? Ten dollar bet on the Tulpar game lol
No betting in this room please Elnur 😂 play for sweets
Sweets it is 🍬
Tomorrow at the Hippodrome: Dastgoh is at home vs Talas? No wait, that is Saturday the 14th, Talas v Dastgoh 21:00 at the State Hippodrome. Is that right?
Yes, ISEZ round 10 on Saturday: Talas v Dastgoh 21:00 at the State Hippodrome, and Köhne Diz v Kyzyl-Adyr 19:00 there too
Ulak! My horses are ready for Saturday, Talas and Dastgoh, come watch
Maybe, depends on the cashier shift again 🙃
Sunday is the Tulpar women's game? Ah no, women's league is done. Attelkom women lost to Neftchi 3-0 last round, Tulpar drew 2-2 with Akademiya. Tulpar won the women's league anyway
Women's league champions Tulpar! Proud 🏆
Anyone else's Tulpar chat app crawling this evening? Or is it just me again
Just you, Tulpar is fine 😂
Thursday exchange was yesterday. Next one is the 20th, Tündük teahouse, 18:30. Come, bring boorsok 🥟
Rahmat! I went last Thursday, my Iradi is still chala but I'll try
Chala is fine Rustam, that's what the exchange is for 😊
Heating in my flat is still warm. The district says it's on everywhere. Good
Mine too. Potato store is cold but the lights are on 💡
Talas 97 tonight, Nurzhan still 149. Rustam, you should be happy at home 😏
Moving back is not on the list. Refinery is worse than the air in the bazar
Going to Nurzhan on Sunday? Anyone need a ride, my car has new tyres from my own shop 😎
Marat, your tyres are the only good thing in the district 😂
Ulak Saturday 14th at the Hippodrome, Talas v Dastgoh 21:00, and Köhne Diz v Kyzyl-Adyr 19:00. Plan your evening
Iyık Janyl v Nurzhan at 16:00 at the Cathedral Field, same day. Nurzhan still in the hunt
Iyık Janyl v Nurzhan is ulak? No, that is football. Ulak is at the Hippodrome. Sorry, my head is in the till
Haha, true. Iyık Janyl v Nurzhan is ulak at the Cathedral Field, the ISEZ conference. OK I'm out of football
Nurbek, Iyık Janyl v Nurzhan at 16:00 is ulak. Football is Tulpar and Neftchi, we already did that 😂
Highland ulak: Boztorgoy v Chubar at Arslanbob, 15:00. Chubar hasn't won in weeks, I'll bet on the horses
Boztorgoy top of the highland table. 24 pts, 8 played. Hard to catch
Whatever it is, my kids will want to watch it. Ulak is ulak 🐴
Gulzada, I'm bringing the kids to the Hippodrome too. Dress warm
Anyone free for chai tomorrow after the early shift?
I'm in. Tündük 15:00?
Good. Bring your charger, I'll show you the new wifi password 😂
Shake hands for a deal first 🤝
Kids want the new Tulpar scarves. 3rd time this month 🧣
Scarves at the Attelkom kiosk. The red ones are good quality
Tulpar 2nd place, nice season 🏆
Talas air 91 at 21:00 says the app. Windows shut again 🙄
Frost tonight, -2 in Talas. Big coat
Big coat again 🧥
Night birds! Tomorrow ulak and chai, enjoy 🌙
Night all. Sweets for Elnur, don't forget 🍬
Got it 😄
Night. Dig nothing 🥔
Early shift again. Tınç uyku
Night Talas 🌙
Night. Cashier shift tomorrow, cash count at 6 🙃
Still awake. Teller shift at 8, my brain is already counting bills 😴
Kayırluu tañ! Went to the stables already. Frost on the water trough, horses not happy about it
Kayırluu tañ all. Kids in full winter gear already, the youngest refused to put on the hat 🙄
Hat is the most important part Gulzada. Potatoes don't care but people do
Saat toguzda 3 gradus here at the Old City. Tomorrow with the Tündük chai I bring a thermos
Thermos + boorsok = I'm in. Anyone going to the Thursday exchange next week?
Ooba, I'll be there. Still practising my 'rahmat' accent 😅
Your accent is fine Rustam, the grammar is what we work on 😉
Anyone checked the 14 bus to Semiz? Trans-Talas lane closure still there?
Looks clear now. Driver said the works are done by Monday
Phone shop next to the Attelkom kiosk just fixed my screen for 1 som lol. Nice guy, but ask first
Rustam, which kiosk? Half my cash counter is on Telegram at this point 😂
The one with the red scarves in the window. I work at the counter behind it, come by 😄
Ulak board at the Hippodrome: Talas plays Dastgoh tonight at 21:00. Gulzada, the kids can come if they wear hats 😄
We'll come! Hat negotiation is ongoing 🧢
Talas v Dastgoh at 21:00 is the one that matters for the ISEZ table. Talas 22 pts, Chu 23 pts on top
Chu v Sary-Bulak is at 17:00 on the Chu ground too. Chu have 9 played, so they'd like a safe win
Potatoes at the Bazar, 2.10 som a kilo now, still cheap for a sack. Ask the inner rows, not the front
Bakyt you are always the potato man 😂
Saat sekizde Talas 12 gradus? No. Air app says Talas 94 today, moderate. Windows open for 10 min then shut
Nurzhan is 122 on the app, sensitive groups. My cousin has the inhaler out again 😞
Nurzhan 122 is why I moved to Talas. The refinery smell is not something I miss
Exchange booth: USD 11.45 buy, 11.95 sell this morning. Rates quiet, people waiting for the Kazakh news
Not my desk but I heard the same. Nobody wants dollars when the som is this steady
Steady is the word. Official rate still 8.40 since 2008, nobody's complaining 😂
Quick question for the English lovers: how do you say 'ulak' in English? I keep saying 'the goat game' to my students 🐐
Goat polo lol. The tourists always say it
Don't tell them goat, horse. Ulak is a horse game, the goat is just the ball of the old days
Ok I'll tell them horse polo, close enough 🐴
Anyone know if the Sunday market at Kyzyl-Adyr is open today? Need hay for the kids' goat 😅
Goat not hay. Hay in the valleys is 26 som a bale, Kyzyl-Adyr is cheaper if you buy 10
We have one goat and I'm the one who feeds her 😂 ok 10 bales it is
Anyone see the Talas Herald piece on the Jibek Jolu fire report? Still no date
Yes, court adjourned until the report. My aunt says she heard it from the stall owners, no date
Sorry Nurbek. Hope she gets her stall back soon
Rahmat. Selling dumplings from home now, come Thursday
Timur what happened? Tulpar lost again?
Tulpar lost 2-1 to Neftchi on the 31st. Still second. Wounded but ok
Neftchi champions, nothing to do about it. Next season
Football fans can stop the sad stickers. Highland ulak today: Chubar v Boztorgoy at Arslanbob 15:00 (not in Talas, I know 😂)
Boztorgoy top with 24, Chubar 12. Hard to see Chubar winning but Marat has never been wrong about horses. Not yet
Anyone free for chai at Tündük tomorrow at 15:00? Same as last week
Yes I'm in. Going to bring the charger like Elnur said 😄
Shake hands first 🤝
Half-day for the teachers next week, the centre closes at 13:00 on Friday. Good news for everyone 🎉
Lucky. Kara-Bulak ulak sold out? My cousin wanted tickets for the Hippodrome tonight
Hippodrome has seats left for the 21:00. Bring your own blanket, the benches are cold
Cold already. Frost tonight on the marshrutka route, -5 in Talas they say. Big coat 🧥
Talas low -5. Nurzhan -2. Iyık Janyl stays warm, 5 at night. Better to be in the valley
Toktogul is -1 at night. Reservoir at 84% and dropping, the power boys say it's fine
Reservoir 84.3%, that is 16.02 of 19 km³. Still good for winter
Lower Naryn v Kara-Bulak is ulak at Tash-Kömür at 16:00. Naryn lost a lot of games, let's see
Kara-Bulak ulak, yes. Not football, Nurbek 😂
I know, I know. Football is Tulpar and Neftchi
Whole family at the kiosk, the red scarves sold out again. Kids are very upset 🧣
Kiosk owner says the new batch comes Monday. Tell the kids to wait
Dinner break, plov at the bazar, 28 som a plate. Still the best deal in town
Ok I'm going for plov too. Tell me you saved me a seat
Talas v Dastgoh at the Hippodrome in 2 hours. Who is going?
We are! Kids in hats 🧢🧢🧢
Good. I'll be by the stables with my two horses, come say hello
Rahmat. Can someone tell me if a 1-room flat in Talas is still 1,000-1,500 som a month? My cousin is looking
Yes, 1,000-1,500 for a 1-room in Talas. Nurzhan 750-1,200. Iyık Janyl is the bargain, 600-1,000
Iyık Janyl is 2 hours on the bus though. 45 som. Not for everyone
Tell your cousin to check the building heating first. Half the cheap flats are cold
Hey, Timur, did you see Cathedral Field is booked for the Iyık Janyl v Nurzhan ulak at 16:00 tomorrow?
Yes, tomorrow 16:00, Cathedral Field. Iyık Janyl 29 pts, Nurzhan 15 pts in ISEZ. I'll watch from the stands
Good ulak tonight, Talas v Dastgoh 21:00. Talas will win, I feel it in my knees 🐴
Your knees are not an official source Marat 😂
Whatever happens, the kids are happy. Ulak is ulak 🐴
Pine smoke in Talas tonight, it's the heating season. Window still open?
No, shut! AQI 93 in Iyık Janyl and 94 here, moderate but my throat says no 😷
Gulzada, the scarves at the kiosk are back? I saw a box coming in
Monday the kiosk said. Not today! 😤
Talas v Dastgoh is at the Hippodrome. Who is cheering? Sending the horses' best to the rider
Going from the Hippodrome, no score yet, I'll tell you when it's over
Talas v Dastgoh result not in yet on my phone. Waiting
Night all. Potatoes need me at 5 🥔
Night. Kids are asleep with hats on 😂
Night. Early shift again tomorrow. Tınç uyku
Night Talas. Cash count at 6 again 🙃
Night 🌙
Night birds, see you at chai tomorrow 🍵

nurzhan.t: Не спится. Батарея в спальне тёплая, в зале ледяная 🥶
Доброе утро. Смена B, опять туман над заводом
Доброе утро! Нуржан 150 по воздуху, Гидромет советует утром не открывать окна 😷
Свет, у меня уже с вечера окна закрыты. Дети кашляют
Вот и я про то же. Лекарство от аллергии в аптеке кончилось, завтра привезут
Инверсия держится, ветра почти нет. По нашим замерам сегодня тоже будет плохо к вечеру
Morning! Is the air always this bad here? In Talas it was ok yesterday 😕
Айгерим, нет, не всегда. Зимой когда котельные на полную, тогда и душно. Талас сейчас 91, у нас 150
Дастгох опять без воды до 14:00? Громкоговоритель молчит 😅
Аиб, это вчера было. Сегодня с утра вода есть, набрала 👍
Ну хоть вода 😄 Всем хорошего дня, я на Навбахор через полчаса
Газ для котельных так и не назвали цену. Herald опять писал, десять миллионов и тишина
Тишина — это тоже тариф 🙃
Кто-нибудь знает, сколько сейчас доллар на Бazар-и Калане? Надо девятьсот перевести сыну в Талас
Утром в меняльных 11.45 покупка, 11.95 продажа. Официальный 8.40, но кто там по официальному меняет 😂
Ох. Ладно, подожду до пятницы, может, упадёт
Не упадёт, нефтяники прогнозируют, что весной ещё выше
Я не прогнозирую, я в смене 🙂
В Талас в пятницу кто едет? Маршрутка 38, я в 13:00 на гейте 3
Я в пятницу в Талас на склад, могу с тобой, Аиб
Давай, место займу 👍
Сегодня первый раз в Dastgoh market, bought apples and walnuts. Walnuts 22 som, that's crazy 😳
Айгерим, ну вот, теперь понимаешь, почему я ворчу 😄
Яблоки в Чу 3.45 по оптовой, у нас по тройному. Кто-то возит
Яблоки из Чу дешевле, но дорога до нас 2 дня. Ну зато не 22 за орехи
Вопрос в группу. Кто может помочь с переводом методички на русский для Айгерим? Она сама просила
Yes please 🙏 I can read Russian slowly, but the chemistry words are hard
Пришли, посмотрю вечером. У меня с химией проблем нет 😊
Rahmat! 🙏
Андрей, это что, твоя? 😂
Моя. Смена B, с полпятого, сейчас в столовой завода
Бухгалтерия сдана! Кто-нибудь знает, есть ли в субботу футбол у Нефтчи? Кубок на 7-м был, а тут тихо
Нефтчи выиграли Кубок Ирада 2–0 у Аттелкома, это было 7-го. В субботу ничего, сезон закончен, чемпионы уже мы 🏆
Чемпионы! 63 очка, Тулпар на 62. Одно очко отрыв
Ой, точно. Забыла, что 27 туров уже всё
Ulak по субботе: Иык-Жаныл Нуржан в 16:00 на Кафедральном поле, 14 ноября. Талас Дастгох в 21:00 на ипподроме
Аиб, это 14-го, не сегодня. Записал, мы с Айгерим пойдём на 16:00
Yes! I want to see ulak 🐎
Иык-Жаныл сегодня 72, у нас 150. Дышать можно, но детей гулять не пущу
Талас 91, у нас в два раза хуже. Наверное, опять инверсия
Инверсия, она самая 🌫️
Ребят, после 19:00 маршрутка Нуржан–Талас только частники? Тот же вопрос что вчера 😅
Да, после 19 частники, 60. Или до 18:30 успеете на 38
Понял. Уже бегу 🏃
Tulparcoin на полдень 3.44, минус 6.4% за день. Всё, я закрыл приложение 🙃
Андрей, ты опять как брокер 😂
Лучше бы я в Tulparcoin держала, чем доллары покупала по 11.95 😂
Оксана, не надо, я уже нервничаю за детей, не за монеты 🙈
Коллеги, в Политехе на следующей неделе лекция про монеты Рабат-и-Сафеда. Дилноза, ты выступаешь?
Да, но пока только про вес и состав серебра. Про музей и университет не буду, это не моё 🙂
Дилноза, а про караханидов что-то будет?
Будет, немного 😉
Good evening! Dastgoh water tomorrow? 😅
Айгерим, завтра не знаю, но вчера уже был опыт 😄
Новая школа на Навбахоре: дочь говорит, что столовую обещают в конце ноября. Опять 😒
Ну хоть солнечные панели на крыше. Светит, наверное, только в ясные дни
Кто завтра на Талас на ISEZ? Ну, на 14-е. Я точно не в Талас, а в Нуржане в пятницу не играют
Иык-Жаныл Нуржан в субботу в 16:00, Кафедральное поле. Талас Дастгох в 21:00, ипподром
Спасибо, всё-таки в субботу ulak. Ещё Кызыл-Адыр 19:00 Köhne Diz 🐎
Смотрю Тулпар. Игорь, Сургут в ноябре будем или нет?
Андрей, решили же: наличные по миллиону, через Казахстан. Ты же читал
Читал. Через Talasbank 1,2–2,5%, а по доллару в меняльной сейчас 11.95. Считай сам
Андрей, ты всё считаешь. Считай лучше, сколько до пятницы 🙂
Good night! Pleased to meet you all 🙏
Спокойной ночи, Айгерим 🌙
Инверсия ещё на ночь. Окна закрыть, батареи проверить
Ночи 🙃
Ночи. Чай с вареньем, как вчера 🫖
Ночи всем. Завтра домой пораньше, отчёт закрыт
Спокойной ночи, Нуржан
Доброе утро, Нуржан 🙂 Дома +14, батареи чуть тёплые. Это уже прогресс
